cause: ReportView restored saved exclusions when opening a history record but left the prior curation state in place when the user started a new report.

evidence.ref: npm test -- --run src/report/ReportView.test.tsx -t starts a new report with all facts included

impact: A fresh report could silently omit facts excluded from the previous report, although the source Run remained unchanged.
lesson: Report curation state must distinguish a selected immutable revision from a new draft; reset omission state when starting a new report and restore it only when reopening history.
